reason: Opened agent QA-20261121-203241-y43e, sent "Hello! What is 2+2?", and confirmed the reply contains 4.
steps: Navigated to http://localhost:47891 — the Gamut home page loaded with the sidebar listing both agents.
Clicked the QA-20261121-203241-y43e agent in the sidebar — its agent page opened at /agents/qa-20261121-203241-y43e-kv19e0ho2h.
Verified agent status — the header status indicator reads "idle", which is an allowed status.
Typed "Hello! What is 2+2?" into the message box — the text appeared and the send button became enabled.
Clicked send — a new session "Simple Arithmetic Question" opened, the user message appeared, and the activity indicator showed "Working...".
Waited up to 3 minutes for the response — "Working..." cleared and the agent returned within that window (the status went back to idle).
Verified the response and took a screenshot (step5-response.png) — the final assistant message reads "2 + 2 = 4.", which contains "4".
